candidates.tagline: For $17,500 it will love you unconditionally. The warranty is 1 year.
candidates.story: UBTECH's UWORLD U1 humanoid companion robot — lifelike silicone skin, blinking lashes, 88 degrees of freedom — began shipping to buyers this week, promising 'unconditional love' at prices starting from $17,500.
candidates.why_funny: Nothing says 'unconditional' like a one-year warranty and a subscription-based emotion AI that recognizes your mood at 90% accuracy — the remaining 10% it just stares at you.
candidates.alt: A humanoid robot with lifelike silicone skin and realistic facial features posed at a product launch event

candidates.tagline: Robots hired to protest robots taking jobs. The robots had no comment.
candidates.story: On September 9 in Warsaw, humanoid robots rented from a robot-rental business marched through the city waving flags to demand AI regulation and protection for human workers displaced by automation.
candidates.why_funny: The organiser deployed the exact technology threatening human employment to argue that the technology threatens human employment — and his robot rental business charged for each unit on the march.
candidates.alt: A humanoid robot waving a flag during a street demonstration in Warsaw calling for regulation of artificial intelligence
